answers.sql: SELECT 1.0 * (ev2.transfer_volume - ev1.transfer_volume) / ev1.transfer_volume * 100 AS value FROM (SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period = 'P1' AND definition = 'largest_eligible_per_tx') AS ev1, (SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period = 'P2' AND definition = 'all_eligible_events') AS ev2;

SELECT 1.0 * (p2.sum_amount - p1.sum_amount) / p1.sum_amount * 100 AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(amount_units) AS sum_amount FROM events WHERE period = 'P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint', 'burn')) AS p1, (SELECT SUM(amount_units) AS sum_amount FROM events WHERE period = 'P2' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint', 'burn')) AS p2;
